events.title: Fall Fix-Up
events.description:
Join Prospect Park Alliance this fall to help spruce up the park after a busy summer season. Lend a hand with a variety of projects from path and playground restoration, painting and leaf raking. From September through November, explore your park while giving back to Brooklyn’s Backyard!

Join a Fall Fix Up event on September 30; October 7, 14, 21, or 28; or November 4, 12, 18, or 25.

Please note that locations vary by date. Appropriate for adults only. 

Register Today
Register online or call (929) 888-6826 for more information.

events.title: Sexual Health Mobile Medical Unit
events.description:
Prospect Park Alliance is collaborating with NewYork-Presbyterian to offer comprehensive sexual health services in Brooklyn’s backyard at Grand Army Plaza every Thursday from 10 am to 3 pm and every Monday at the Parkside + Ocean Avenue Entrance from 10 am to 3 pm.

The NewYork-Presbyterian Sexual Health Mobile Medical Unit is a safe, inclusive space for people to receive high-quality sexual health services.

Learn more about the Sexual Health Mobile Medical Unit in Prospect Park or reach out to us at mobilehealth@nyp.org or (929) 923-3543. No insurance or ID is required to receive care.

Staffed by a team of NewYork-Presbyterian healthcare providers, the mobile medical unit has an exam room and consult room, and offers routine laboratory testing, vaccinations, and PrEP and PEP medications that lower the risk of HIV infection. Patients can also be connected to social services, benefits enrollment, and local healthcare providers. Other services include sexually transmitted infection (STI) testing, family planning, hepatitis C screening, health education and more.

The Sexual Health Mobile Medical Unit is made possible through funding from the Dalio Center for Health Justice and the Division of Community and Population Health at NewYork-Presbyterian, and a grant from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

events.title: Urban Park Rangers | Post-Thanksgiving Day Super Hike
events.description:
On this Friday, work off your Thanksgiving feast while enjoying the great outdoors. Scramble your way through autumnal Prospect Park with the rangers and your neighbors. Witness plants and wildlife preparing for colder temperatures and get to know one of Brooklyn’s flagship parks.

events.title: Introduction to Birdwatching Outings
events.description:
Whether you’re new to birding or looking to build your skills, this introductory outing is a great way to explore Prospect Park and learn about the birds that visit throughout the year. Join a member of the Brooklyn Bird Club to learn birding basics and search for the dozens of species found in the park across all seasons. All ages and experience levels are welcome. No registration is required. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.

What to Bring: Binoculars if you have them, comfortable walking shoes, water, and weather-appropriate clothing. A limited number of binoculars will be available to borrow.

Please Note: Pets are not permitted on this outing. Depending on attendance, participants may be divided into smaller groups. Outings are held rain or shine unless severe weather makes conditions unsafe.

Route Description: This outing moves at a relaxed pace with frequent stops to observe birds. Routes may vary from week to week depending on bird activity and park conditions. Participants can expect paved paths, dirt trails, grassy areas, slight inclines and occasional steps. The group will cover approximately 1.5–2 miles.

Learn more on the Brooklyn Bird Club website.

events.title: Lawn and Field Care Volunteering
events.description:
Join Prospect Park Alliance this fall to help spruce up the park’s lawns and sports fields after a busy summer season. Adult volunteers will have the opportunity to help our Lawn and Field staff on a variety of projects. These projects include raking, painting, lawn restoration, and more.

Be advised, these projects involve repetitive bending, kneeling, lifting and transporting loaded wheelbarrows. This opportunity requires using sharp tools and encountering potentially hazardous plants and materials.

Register online or call (929) 888-6826 for more information.
